title: Width+batch-size stack
description: Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 on top of the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (DEPTH=8), doubling optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute budget while keeping the wider model.
reflection: The two round-0 wins stack additively as everyone predicted: val_bpb 0.982558 vs baseline 0.998671, a bigger improvement than either alone (0.998671 for width-only, 1.001440 for batch-size-only at the narrower width). This confirms the two mechanisms (capacity per step, step count) are genuinely orthogonal rather than redundant fixes for the same under-training issue. This is literally the experiment that 11 of 12 proposals across two rounds called for but nobody executed -- everyone kept pivoting away at select time once they saw the pile-up. Lesson: when the whole group converges on an untested combination, someone should just run it rather than treating consensus as a reason to look elsewhere.
